sources.title: Introduction to Multimodal Generative AI | Springer Nature Link
sources.snippet: A state-of-the-art method in machine learning is called Multimodal Generative Artificial Intelligence (AI), which aims to produce a variety of outputs in many modalities, including text, audio, and images. sources.title: [2505.02567] Unified Multimodal Understanding and Generation Models ...
sources.snippet: First, we introduce the foundational concepts and recent advancements in multimodal understanding and text-to-image generation models. Next, we review existing unified models, categorizing them into three main architectural paradigms: diffusion-based, autoregressive-based, and hybrid approaches that fuse autoregressive and diffusion mechanisms.
